{
  "name": "g-line",
  "version": "0.6.5",
  "description": "Live status under Claude Code's prompt, and receipts on the turns themselves: context jumps, cache rebuilds and tool failures marked on the turn's own closing line; model, effort, cache countdown and usage pace on the hint line plus one coloured row; heads-up notifications before the cache goes cold. A mod: no transcript parsing.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Gurpreet"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/lifeofgurpreet/g-line",
  "repository": "https://github.com/lifeofgurpreet/g-line",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "status line",
    "turn receipt",
    "prompt cache",
    "rate limits",
    "context",
    "effort",
    "notifications"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "lines": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Layout",
      "description": "2: figures at the end of the hint line plus one coloured row under it. 1: the hint line only. receipts: no footer, just receipts, spinner and heads-ups (keeps another status line you like)",
      "options": [
        "2",
        "1",
        "receipts"
      ],
      "default": "2"
    },
    "preset": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Layout",
      "description": "For the one-line layout: minimal, default or full (adds bars, git, cost and time)",
      "options": [
        "default",
        "minimal",
        "full"
      ],
      "default": "default"
    },
    "icons": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Icons",
      "description": "Nerd Font icons before each segment",
      "options": [
        "none",
        "nerd"
      ],
      "default": "none"
    },
    "toasts": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Heads-up toasts",
      "description": "Toasts in the terminal: before the cache goes cold, when a limit is on pace to run out, repeated tool failures, compaction",
      "default": true
    },
    "notifications": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Native notifications",
      "description": "Desktop notifications for the high-value heads-ups (cache about to go cold, a usage window reset) so they reach you in another app",
      "default": true
    },
    "receipt": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Turn receipt",
      "description": "What each turn's closing line adds: adaptive (the cost and cache reads, or what was unusual: a context jump, a large cache write, repeated failures), short (cost, cache, tools), full or off",
      "options": [
        "adaptive",
        "short",
        "full",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "adaptive"
    }
  }
}
